اعلوطتما (form XIII)
# اِعْلَوَّطْتُمَا (iʕlawwaṭtumā) /iʕ.law.watˤ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
# اُعْلُوِّطْتُمَا (uʕluwwiṭtumā) /uʕ.luw.witˤ.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِعْلَوَّطَ (iʕlawwaṭa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
